# Agents Window

For implementation, review or design in this area, use the [sessions skill](../../.agents/skills/sessions/SKILL.md).

For visual work, read [Sessions style](../../src/ash/sessions/STYLE.md); Workbench visual rules and default role assignments do not apply here. Shared token registration and CSS variable naming still follow [design-tokens.instructions.md](design-tokens.instructions.md).
